Filmed in early 1991. Released in 1992. Pretty neat to see Pearl jam, soundG, and Alice before they broke out.
 Nevermind was Sept 1991..So it was really filmed before grunge exploded. Was a niche local movie ...You can't time it better if you tried
 It's funny, when Matt Dillon is saying where is the misty mountain hop of our generation... The iron Man... Smoke on the water .....Meanwhile, the film was sitting right on top of the next Gen anthems/bands
 It was also fun to see 20s dating from a middle aged perspective. I felt bad for the generic straight edge guy trying to date within a scene of artsy music free spirit rebels like Matt Dillon (Just like the Ben Stiller character in Reality Bites)
 It's like the office guy has to apologize for having his shit together at SB early age. I won
